assumptions: Stable upstream identity is supplied by governed discovery/model providers.
Camera frames are supplied by the governed external camera owner.
Astronomy morphology or density hints retain their upstream authority and are only consumed as presentation context here.
limitations: Generated galaxy density particles, dust cues, clusters, morphology components and fallback presentation coordinates are presentation-only and are not calibrated observations.
The provider does not own camera, semantic scale, canonical selection, temporal state, persistence, registry semantics, central resource admission or astronomical equations.
Decorative particles are never canonical discovery results and are never selectable or navigable.
Region interpolation communicates continuity but is not a claim of physical motion or canonical region boundaries; reduced-motion mode removes the continuous blend.
The galaxy render packet reports modeled batch usage only; GPU, driver and heap memory are not measured by this lane.

fidelity.validity: Deterministic identity-keyed macrocosm presentation for Universe, Galaxy, Region and Neighborhood contexts under externally governed inputs.
fidelity.resolution: At most 64 represented upstream entities, 96 region children and bounded quality-profile decorative fields; galaxy batching remains at most 3 draws with modeled upload accounting.
fidelity.uncertainty: Generated spatial/morphological cues are presentation-only; stronger upstream positions or facts retain their declared authority without promotion.
